section_summary.extract_value: This section reports between-group differences in BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) scores comparing men and women, as well as across universities. The analysis included 1031-1032 participants and found that men had significantly higher BAS-2 total scores than women (t(1031) = 2.37, p = .021), though the effect size was small (d = 0.15). No significant differences in body appreciation were found across universities (F(6, 1025) = 0.69, p = .660).
